investigation_notes.Description: High-entropy DNS TXT queries to ntp-update.space from srv-prod-web-02 contained subdomain labels that decode to cleartext host attributes (hostname, OS, uptime) and a command field, indicating data is being embedded in DNS queries. The root domain ntp-update.space was registered on 2026-02-05 (approximately 26 days old) and the observed record sizes (740 bytes vs typical 20) are anomalous for normal DNS activity. Given the production host context, the encoded payloads revealing host-identifying metadata, and the recent domain registration, the activity is consistent with DNS-based exfiltration or C2 and warrants escalation.
